## Accepted credited outcome
Already_solved0/5: Bowen's published2015 result, with ABBG2021/2023 repaired approximation dependency, gives a uniform full round-limit-set dimension gap below3 for arbitrary-rank free convex-cocompact groups in real Isom(H4). No new discovery or numerical optimal gap is claimed.

## Repairs and independent acceptance
The mandatory ADDITIVE_DOMAIN_CLARIFICATION.md replaces the historical initial reduction with positive actual domain ratios (including h=0), Buser1982 smoothing, finite-component thickening, full-preimage normal finite covers and safe metric-isometric radii. It establishes infinite volume for the bottom-spectrum deduction and bypasses the original random-net/normalization defects. Every-radius volume, EVERY weighted ambient-net nerve, boundary/Mayer–Vietoris, lattice interleaving, free-G2 quantifiers and spectrum branches were independently reconstructed and challenged. The exact target family suffices.

Two initial independent families, a new whole-package adversary and root replays pass exact revised head f8a700bf81558761a7341d7f56d1eb8baf943f11. All19 inputs and15 final-review artifacts are root hash-verified; all9+5 historical artifacts are unchanged. Portable controls pass58,717 author and80,000 historical independent assertions. Root privately reproduces the complete new final controls and checks the analytic dependency constant repairs. Finite counts do not compute an existence constant. The review is extensively AI-assisted, not external human peer review. Full acceptance record: draft_pr_descending_audit_20261002/audits/pr387_6200082/ACCEPTANCE_DECISION.json and repaired_final_adversary/REVIEW.md.

## Disposition scope
Accepted as credited prior findings; main-preserving integration and actual merge are being verified. Only18 target files and the single QUEUE status cell change; turns remain0/5. No arbitrary geometrically infinite full-limit-set extension, new paper, Zenodo, DOI, tracker row or GitHub release.
